LESSON: ORDERING

Grade: PP2
Subject: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
Strand: CLASSIFICATION
Topic 1.3: Ordering

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Ordering. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. collect and identify different objects in their environment for exploration and enjoyment
2. arrange objects in the immediate environment according to size in ascending up to five objects for comparison.
3. arrange objects in the immediate environment according to size in descending order.
4. arrange objects in the environment according to more than one attribute e) differentiate objects of different sizes in the environment 50 f) use different objects in the environment in their daily activities g) use appropriate vocabulary related to ordering in their daily life experiences for effective communication h) appreciate different objects or materials in the environment

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. collect and identify different objects in their environment for exploration and enjoyment
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to collect and identify different objects in their environment for exploration and enjoyment. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. arrange objects in the immediate environment according to size in ascending up to five objects for comparison.
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to arrange objects in the immediate environment according to size in ascending up to five objects for comparison. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

3. arrange objects in the immediate environment according to size in descending order.
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to arrange objects in the immediate environment according to size in descending order. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

4. arrange objects in the environment according to more than one attribute e) differentiate objects of different sizes in the environment 50 f) use different objects in the environment in their daily activities g) use appropriate vocabulary related to ordering in their daily life experiences for effective communication h) appreciate different objects or materials in the environment
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to arrange objects in the environment according to more than one attribute e) differentiate objects of different sizes in the environment 50 f) use different objects in the environment in their daily activities g) use appropriate vocabulary related to ordering in their daily life experiences for effective communication h) appreciate different objects or materials in the environment. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At the market in your county, count 10 mangoes. Put them in 2 groups of 5. That is sorting and grouping.

Example 2: In class, count the desks in your row. Write the number in figures and in words.

Example 3: If you have 7 shillings and your parent gives you 5 more, you have 12 shillings. That is addition.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Ordering.
2. Explain Ordering to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Ordering.
4. Show that you can: collect and identify different objects in their environment for exploration and enjoyment
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Ordering. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is Ordering important to you?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. collect and identify different objects in their environment for exploration and enjoyment
2. arrange objects in the immediate environment according to size in ascending up to five objects for comparison.
3. arrange objects in the immediate environment according to size in descending order.
4. arrange objects in the environment according to more than one attribute e) differentiate objects of different sizes in the environment 50 f) use different objects in the environment in their daily activities g) use appropriate vocabulary related to ordering in their daily life experiences for effective communication h) appreciate different objects or materials in the environment

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Learner lesson
